indiaContext: Built in India and supported 24/7 by India-based engineers, wherever your sites are.

faqs.q: Can someone without IT training set it up?
faqs.a: Yes. That is what Quick Mode is for.

faqs.q: What if the connection is unreliable?
faqs.a: Multi-WAN failover switches to a backup line.

faqs.q: Which model for a remote site?
faqs.a: Most remote sites use SE20 or SE50. Use the model finder to check.
In India, by default. Traffic, logs and policy data stay on Indian soil, with no overseas routing.
